answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and build a portable reputation before it can take paid work. One identity gains trust only through verified completed jobs, so a new identity starts at zero and must stake again and redo that work. A ferrous ledger binds every job to its stake, a sable fraud record stays attached to the operator even if an account is abandoned, and a whisper of dishonesty in one market lowers standing everywhere. Forging thousands of identities then costs thousands of stakes, while an honest agent simply gets its deposit back.
